Requirements and measured costs for registered methods

method_requirements.Rd

Lists dependencies beyond core Imports and, when available, measured PB1 fit time, per-specimen scoring time, peak memory and frozen model size. Measurements describe the recorded data, hardware and settings, not a speed guarantee.

Usage

method_requirements(methods = NULL, families = NULL)

Arguments

methods

Optional method identifiers. NULL selects all unless families is set.

families

Optional roster family letters. Methods and families select their union.

Value

A data frame with one row per method. Dependencies are separated by semicolons. Optional R implementations are listed separately. Cost columns are medians of completed CPU cells. Missing measurements are NA. The measurements attribute contains full cells with source and hardware. User callbacks without dependency declarations have requirements_known = FALSE.

Examples

method_requirements("ws-rclr-trimmed")
#>         method_id family tier dep_route                           family_name
#> 1 ws-rclr-trimmed      A   R1    base-R Compositional within-sample baselines
#>   r_packages optional_r_packages python_modules model_weights      gpu
#> 1                                                             not used
#>                                       requirements_source requirements_known
#> 1 v2.6.9 registry and dependency guards; PB1 source audit               TRUE
#>   fit_seconds score_seconds_per_specimen peak_memory_bytes frozen_model_bytes
#> 1   0.3648827                 0.02434671         178630656              72429
#>                                                                               measuring_node
#> 1 Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8380 CPU @ 2.30GHz: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8380 CPU @ 2.30GHz
#>                                                     cost_status
#> 1 median of completed PB1 CPU cells; see measurements attribute
